patterns.note: Main content sections are contained within large, rounded-corner rectangles, often with alternating light background colors.
Circular image masks are frequently used for individual product displays and lifestyle shots, creating a soft, playful presentation.
A distinctive, rounded, 'bubbly' display font is used for all primary section headings, creating a playful and memorable brand voice.
A warm, light beige background provides a soft, neutral canvas that allows vibrant product photography and accent colors to pop.
The top promotional banner and the main navigation bar remain fixed at the top of the viewport as the user scrolls down the page.
Product grids often utilize circular image crops to showcase individual items, breaking from typical rectangular product cards.

technique_notes: Implement a fixed header that includes both a promotional banner and the main navigation, ensuring it remains visible at the top of the viewport during scroll.
Apply a generous, consistent border-radius to all major content sections, image containers, and interactive elements like buttons and input fields, creating a soft and approachable aesthetic.
Utilize a custom, bold, and rounded sans-serif font for all primary headings to establish a unique and playful brand identity, contrasting with a more conventional sans-serif for body text.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, rounded, bold display headings (~3-4x body) with smaller, often uppercase sans-serif subheadings and standard body text.
design_tokens.radius: Pill-like rounded corners applied consistently to all major containers, images, and interactive elements.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy and balanced, with generous vertical padding between sections and ample whitespace around content blocks.

standout: The site's distinctive design is defined by its playful, almost cartoonish, rounded display font used for all major headings, paired with a consistent application of large, pill-like rounded corners across all UI elements. This creates a soft, approachable, and memorable brand aesthetic that stands out from typical e-commerce sites.
